name: Zero Power Robot (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 零次方机器人(深圳)有限公司
summary:
Zero Power Robot develops embodied robot platforms under the ZERITH brand. Its public portfolio includes humanoid and wheeled dual-arm designs, combining physical mobility with manipulation for research, education, industrial work, commercial services and household assistance.

The wheeled platform uses a vertically adjustable body and long-reach arms to handle objects at different heights. Its design supports activities such as grasping, carrying and collecting interaction data for AI development. The company presents its robots as configurable physical platforms that connect higher-level intelligence with motion control, allowing developers and application partners to explore tasks across several operating environments.
